methodology.authority: U.S. Department of Defense / Naval Sea Systems Command
methodology.method_scope: Part-stress electronic-equipment reliability prediction; handbook guidance, not a contractual requirement by itself.
methodology.implementation_scope: Every numerical part-stress model in Sections 5-23, the Section 5/6/10/11 calculation aids, all 217 Appendix A parts-count rows, and all seven Appendix B CMOS mechanisms, with clause/page, factor, substitution, assumption, warning, and unit traceability.
methodology.known_exclusions: No numerical model exclusions within Sections 5-23 or Appendices A-B. Sections 1-4 are narrative guidance rather than additional calculation models. Printed source conflicts and adopted interpretations are enumerated in the repository coverage matrix; project tailoring and independent design verification remain required.
clause_coverage: Sections 5-23: all printed part-stress models and calculation aids
Appendix A: all 217 distinct generic parts-count rows
Appendix B: oxide, metallization, hot-carrier, contamination, package/humidity, EOS/ESD, and miscellaneous mechanisms

source.title: ASSIST MIL-HDBK-217 document record
source.access: controlled local Notice 2 PDF plus public document record

authoritative_example_validation.note: Eight printed handbook worked examples pass, supplemented by all-row/style tests, independent Appendix B recomputation, and piecewise-boundary tests. See docs/standards/MIL-HDBK-217F-NOTICE-2-COVERAGE.md.

tier_definition.label: Verified implementation
tier_definition.meaning: Clause coverage is mapped and authoritative worked examples pass. Any exclusions are explicit.
tier_definition.contract_use: Record project-specific tailoring and verification with the selected standard.

result.result_context: MIL-HDBK-217F provides the operating planning estimate. When operating exposure is below 100%, the calendar-time service rate uses the separately identified RADC-TR-85-91 nonoperating extension; it is not a field-rate forecast without representative test or field evidence.

methodology_supplements.authority: Rome Air Development Center, U.S. Air Force Systems Command
methodology_supplements.method_scope: Component-level nonoperating failure-rate models and equations for combining operating and nonoperating exposure.
methodology_supplements.implementation_scope: Appendix A Sections 5.2.1 through 5.2.15: reliability and service-life equations plus microelectronics, hybrids, magnetic bubble memories, discrete semiconductors, tubes, lasers, resistors, capacitors, inductive and rotating devices, relays, switches, connectors, PTH assemblies, connections, and miscellaneous parts. Every result carries report-section, page, table, equation, maturity, assumption, warning, and unit metadata.
methodology_supplements.known_exclusions: Section 4.5 excludes satellite applications, so printed SF placeholder factors are rejected. Undefined exact boundaries (hybrid discriminator 12.2 and relay/switch contact voltage 50 mV) and missing family/environment table cells fail closed. The time-varying spacecraft procedure in RADC-TR-85-229 is separate.
clause_coverage: 5.2.1: nonoperating, service-life, and combined reliability equations
